title: Wildcard in Match
concept: The underscore _ in match acts as a catch-all — it matches any value not already matched by earlier arms.
why: The wildcard ensures your match is exhaustive — every possible value is handled, preventing runtime errors from unhandled cases.
tips: `_` is the wildcard — it matches ANYTHING
`_` must be the LAST arm — arms are checked in order
`_` makes your match exhaustive, satisfying the compiler
Use `_` when you don't need the actual value, just 'everything else'
common_mistakes: Putting `_` before other arms — earlier arms become dead code
Forgetting `_` entirely — match won't compile without it for unbounded types
Using `_` when you should handle a specific case — be intentional
